look: Use case: photorealistic-natural. WhiskedAway FLOURISH kitchen, same lived-in English/Kiwi coastal inn as supplied references. Editorial interiors PHOTOGRAPH for a cookbook, real materials/light, not CGI/illustration. 4.5m x4.5m room, cream limewash #f4efe4, exposed honey oak ceiling beams, worn wide honey-brown floorboards, aged brass #b07f52, deep brown #2c2416. Flourish accent MARIGOLD #d9a441 in creased linen, striped cream/marigold runner with fine green line and a few glazed jugs, plus fresh garden greens (replace Cuddlecore dusty berry). Bright CLEAR EARLY MORNING: low warm sun through open stable-door top on garden side, soft sea-window daylight, long gentle shadows, natural range not HDR. Full-frame24mm, eye1.6m, level verticals, f/4,16:9 landscape, whole room reasonably sharp unless a close-up is requested. No people/animals/text/letters/numbers/readable labels/pseudo-writing/logos/watermarks/plastic/screens/modern appliances. No wallclock/barometer/energycandles: leave some empty plaster beside sea window for later Blender additions. No room dial on inside of hallway door.
layout: LOCKED ROOM LAYOUT: sea wall NORTH has ONE big timber sash window with sunny timber ledge below and just three small clay herb pots. Garden wall EAST has ONE timber stable door, split horizontally, bottom CLOSED, TOP half OPEN; wooden vegetable trug on floor beside it, clear route. Hallway wall WEST has the four-panel old oak hallway door in its FRONT/SOUTH half and a large vintage cream enamel solid-fuel range in its SEA/NORTH half under a shallow plaster chimney hood; cast-iron pan, kettle, copper-pan rail above. Front/SOUTH inside wall has tall cream painted timber dresser with plates/jugs and UNLABELLED glass jars of grains/pulses/nuts/seeds; at dresser's west end a small wood side table displays wind-up brass-horn phonograph with wood case, record, tonearm and side winding crank. Table in CENTRE: big scrubbed pine rectangular table (~1.9x.95m), mismatched wooden chairs, marigold striped runner, bowl of brown eggs, crusty loaf on wooden board, fresh kale/greens/herbs, bowl of oats/seeds. Allow each clickable hero breathing space; useful untidiness, flour/crumbs/soil, not clutter.

Close-up still life on worn kitchen FLOOR beside stable door of a traditional WOODEN SUSSEX GARDEN TRUG. Important: make a broad oval shallow bowl from 5–7 WIDE SOLID CURVED LIGHT-BROWN WOODEN SLATS running lengthwise, fixed into a steam-bent chestnut rim, with one continuous broad bent wood arch handle. Natural accurate materials, restrained patina, even neutral daylight, no CGI gloss. No labels, text, numbers, logos, watermark, people, flowers or extra props.

Use case: illustration-story. A small framed botanical WATERCOLOUR on warm cream textured paper, flat front-on orthographic scan, PORTRAIT4:5. Thin simple honey-oak frame, whole frame visible, plain neutral surrounding margin, evenly lit, no perspective or cast frame shadow. The botanical composition contains ONLY a beetroot with earthy purple-red round root, slender root tip, red stems and natural green leaves; a small spray of deeply crinkled dark-green KALE leaves; and a sprig of ROSEMARY with woody stems and narrow needle-like leaves.
